By default the adapter follows each model's advertise"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"d context window, including updates when the catalog refreshes. Set `contextWindowLimit` for a globa"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"l budget or `modelContextWindowLimits` for individual models; explicit values are used as-is. Sign-i"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"n lives on that row's card."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"For example, add this field to the plugin's configuration to set DSH's context budget to 1,000,000 t"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"okens for models without an individual override, even if the catalog reports a maximum of 872,000. DSH still reserves headroom for compaction; they do not change service-side request limits."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"For separate model budgets, use exact model IDs as dictionary keys. The priority is individual model"},{"id":"p24s2","text":", then global budget, then account default. In this example Astra uses 1,000,000, Sol uses 800,000, "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"and other models use 500,000. The global field is optional; omit it to let other models follow their"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"se 500,000. The global field is optional; omit it to let other models follow their account defaults."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Changes take effect the next time DSH resolves a model. Removing a model entry restores the current "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"global budget, or its account default when no global budget is set. Keys are case-sensitive exact ID"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s, not display names or wildcard patterns."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The share of the plan this installation may spend is set per app, in ChatGPT settings:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Understand the implementation"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Implementation internals — click to expand"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Source | Responsibility |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"For every turn routed to `chatgpt`, the adapter preserves the order of messages, assistant blocks, t"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ool calls, and results. System and developer instructions become developer messages at their origina"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"l positions. DSH is told to append system-prompt updates in history. Native assistant output, includ"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"ing encrypted reasoning, is retained in DSH's `replayState` and replayed for the same authorization,"},{"id":"p33s5","text":" route, and model when the saved content is unchanged."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- **Existing histories remain usable** — older sessions have no encrypted replay state to recover. T"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"heir visible messages and tools are replayed in order. Edited, pruned, foreign, malformed, or incomp"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"atible replay metadata falls back to visible history without reintroducing discarded content. This i"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"ntegration requires a DSH host supporting `finish.replayState` and `systemPromptUpdate: "in-history""},{"id":"p35s5","text":"`; see the replay design and validation plan."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- **One account at a time in the UI** — the host keeps every authorized account separate and can sig"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"n one out by subject, but the card shows and switches only the active account, so adding a second on"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"e means signing out first.
- **Images and files are not sent** — an image or file block carries a du"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"rable attachment reference that this adapter does not resolve, so it reaches the model as the placeh"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"older text `[image omitted: not yet supported]`. The omission is visible rather than silent, but the"},{"id":"p36s6","text":" content is genuinely lost.
- **The plan-usage route is in preview** — computer use, Code Interprete"},{"id":"p36s7","text":"r, file search, hosted MCP, image generation, and `tool_search` are refused upstream regardless of w"},{"id":"p36s8","text":"hat this plugin sends, and `multi_agent`, `temperature`, and `max_output_tokens` are among fifteen f"},{"id":"p36s9","text":"ields that must be omitted.
- **The roster mixes two sources with different authority** — the accoun"},{"id":"p36s10","text":"t's listing supplies advertised models with the endpoint's own metadata; the models this route measu"},{"id":"p36s11","text":"rably serves but the listing omits are added from `src/models/served.ts`, dated by when they were me"},{"id":"p36s12","text":"asured. A listing that changes under a stale measurement will show extras that no longer answer, and"},{"id":"p36s13","text":" `includeUnlisted: false` narrows the roster to the account's own answer.
- **One installation, one "},{"id":"p36s14","text":"host id** — the host id is scoped to the state directory. Two profiles sharing one directory are one"},{"id":"p36s15","text":" installation to OpenAI; two directories are two, and each is consented separately.
